rules.summary: Orders are assigned unless one of the rules below stops them.
A rider on a paid cooling break gets no orders until the break is over.
When the heat index is 38 °C or more and orders are slow, a rider who has worked 70 minutes or more since the last break gets a paid 20-minute break.
When the heat index is 38 °C or more, an order that would take a rider past 100 minutes since the last break is held and the rider gets a paid 20-minute break, except at rush hour.
When the heat index is 38 °C or more, an order that would take a rider past 120 minutes since the last break is held and the rider gets a paid 20-minute break, even at rush hour.
When the heat index is 41 °C or more, orders over 3 km (rounded up) are skipped; the rider stays online for nearer ones.
When the heat index is 46 °C or more, deliveries are paused and the incentive target is reduced for that time.
When the heat index is 38 °C or more, a rider can decline any order without penalty (not a knob).
